Iran denies reports of a US-Israeli missile strike on Qeshm Island. Iranian media reported US-launched missiles hit its outskirts, and a tanker was reported hit in the Strait of Hormuz. Will Hormuz shipping be affected?

tweets.text: The S&P 500 sank 3.7% and the Nasdaq Composite turned negative for the year as the tech sell-off worsened, per AP. Wall Street has now slid into correction territory on AI worries. Have you changed how much you hold in index funds since this drop began?

Reuters reports the Nasdaq fell 5% in a day after Anthropic's debut, and MarketWatch counts a $2.3 trillion weekly wipeout in chip stocks. Those moves say nothing about model quality. Which model do you use for cheap bulk classification when your budget is the thing that gets squeezed?
tweets.topic: AI market selloff and inference budgets

tweets.text: The UN warns Saudi-led strikes on Yemen's Port of Hudaydah threaten a vital aid lifeline. Saudi-led forces struck the port as Houthis warned airlines off the kingdom. What does this mean for aid deliveries into Yemen?

Stock market selloff pushed mortgage rates down, according to RealEstateNews.com. Lower rates change the math for anyone shopping for a home right now. If you were buying this year, would you wait for rates to fall further or lock in today?

A Kansas court says a man's lawsuit and appeal cited fake cases generated with AI. Long legal documents are exactly where teams assume a model's citations are safe. Which model do you use for long-context document review, and how do you check its citations?
tweets.topic: AI hallucinated citations in court filings

tweets.text: Russian missiles landed in Poland as Europe held military drills nearby. NATO calls it a violation, and Poland accuses Russia of 'intentional provocation.'

MLB owners made a draft concession as the salary cap standoff continues, per Yahoo Sports. The Yankees non-tendered Fernando Cruz and Luis Gil, making them free agents, per sources. Would you rather baseball adopt a hard salary cap or keep the luxury tax?

Reuters reports Apollo and Goldman lead a $44 billion debt financing for SpaceX GPUs, and Investor's Business Daily reports $32 billion of debt sold for AI chips. Compute is now being financed with bonds. Which tool do you use for agentic loops when your per-run cost depends on how the financing plays out?
Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza, civil defence says. Will the ceasefire hold?
